Filter by sport, city, country, or date range. Returns

tools.name: search_packages
tools.description: Search hand-curated trip packages bundling event tickets + hotel + experiences with savings vs DIY booking. Packages live on dedicated /packages/ pages and include preview hotel, ticket category, and (sometimes) experience list. Filter by category (concerts, f1, world_cup, tennis, nfl, etc.), city,

tools.name: get_event_details
tools.description: Get full details for one event: title, venue, date and time, price range, description, and image gallery. Provide event_id (UUID) or slug from search_events results.

tools.name: search_hotels_near_event
tools.description: Find hotels within walking or short-transit distance of an event venue. If no check_in/check_out provided, defaults to one night before through one night after the event (2-night stay). Returns nightly price, total cost, distance, transport mode (walk vs rideshare), and travel time to venue.

tools.name: search_experiences
tools.description: Find activities, tours, attractions, food experiences, and nightlife in a city (sourced from Hotelbeds). If no date range provided, defaults to next 7 days. Returns activity name, price, duration, image, and whether free cancellation is offered.

tools.name: build_event_link
tools.description: Generate a deep link to the Event Escapes event detail page. The user lands on a page where they can review ticket categories, see hotels near the venue (auto-loaded), and complete booking themselves. Optionally pass hotel_id to pin a recommended hotel at the top of the hotels-near-venue list. This

tools.name: build_package_link
tools.description: Generate a deep link to a curated Event Escapes PACKAGE detail page (/packages/{slug}). Packages are hand-curated bundles of event tickets + hotel + experiences with savings vs DIY booking. Takes a package_id or slug returned by search_packages. This does not make a reservation: the user reviews tie

tools.name: create_payment_link
tools.description: Creates a booking cart and returns a secure payment URL the customer uses to pay. Locks live prices for up to 4 items (a hotel room from search_hotels_near_event, event tickets from search_events, or an experience from search_experiences, which comes back as a site link for the customer to complete)

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.eventescapes.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_events, search_packages, build_event_link · Private data: create_payment_link · Public sink: create_payment_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_events, search_packages, build_event_link · Private data: create_payment_link · Public sink: create_payment_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_events" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
